content_of_post_to_answer: How can I stop overthinking small problems?
answer: Overthinking small problems often comes from treating every thought as a problem that needs solving. A useful shift is to separate real problems from mental simulations of possible problems. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A calm mind is not one that never thinks; it is one that knows which thoughts deserve attention and which can simply pass.
